releaseNotes: Expands the original SS&S worship-study pathways from 20 to 30 original Bible-based themes, including praise in adversity, intercession, fellowship, the Lord's Supper, mission among the nations and hope in Christ's return. Includes the 85-entry offline word-study library and its related-word fallback, 122 contextual commentary notes and 125 unique faith-response references. Refreshes the offline cache.
